import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Capacity -> Tier 0 (50k units, $85/day). Usage ~700/day, huge headroom. Save $130/day.
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=0))

# 2. Raise quotas: social posts show S1 hitting rate limits (Plan A quota=400 too tight, losing work).
#    Compute is cheap at T2; bigger quota = higher satisfaction/reputation, lower churn.
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=1500, B=6000, C=20000))

# 3. Dev: tilt toward S2 unlock (the $79/mo prize, 167k mkt). Hold total dev = $4000/day.
#    global=1500 (broad, helps all incl enterprise), S1=1000 (conversion+satisfaction), S2=1500 (unlock).
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=300, development=1500))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000, "S2": 1500}))

# 4. Ads: conversion is quality-driven (channel-independent), so MAXIMIZE cheapest channel.
#    content_marketing = 147 leads/$1k for S1 (2.3x social/search 63). Concentrate there; test saturation @600.
#    DROP S3 entirely (0% conversion, all leads lost forever).
#    Small S2 probe ($100/day content_marketing): S2 q_min noisy (0.37 +-65% -> could be 0.13); if floor
#    is actually low, S2 may already convert at plan B (0.2185). High-value info; scale if any convert.
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S1": 600, "S2": 100},
    "social_media": {"S1": 75},
    "search_ads": {"S1": 75},
}))

# 5. Keep: prices A=19/B=79/C=199, tiers A=2/B=3/C=4, lead promo $5 global, ads_strength 0, no R&D, no research.
print("WEEK 1 CONFIG DONE")
